items.name: Graphify-Labs/graphify
items.one_liner: Deterministic code knowledge graphs for AI coding assistants
items.pain_point: Developers waste hours tracing relationships across unfamiliar codebases; vector search loses structural context; onboarding onto large projects is painful. Solo devs and small teams would pay for faster codebase comprehension.
app_ideas: VS Code extension showing interactive code relationship graphs with click-to-navigate traversal
CLI tool for answering 'where does X happen and why' questions with full dependency traces
GitHub PR reviewer bot that explains changes using knowledge graph context instead of just diffs
items.monetization: Freemium with per-project limits for solo devs; team seats + API access for B2B; could white-label as vertical SaaS for security audits or legal tech
items.why_now: AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) are exploding but all use flawed vector search; deterministic graph approaches fill a clear gap in the market
